senses.gloss: गो- + कर्ण गो- + कर्ण, m. 1. a kind of deer, Antelope picta, Rām. 2, 103, 41. 2. a kind of arrow, MBh. 8, 4668. 3. a span from the tip of the thumb to that of the little finger, MBh. 2, 2324. 4. the name of a holy place, Rām. 1, 42, 13. 5. a name of Śiva, Kathās. 22, 218.
गो- + कुल गो- + कुल, n. 1. a herd of kine, Rām. 1, 9, 60. 2. the name of a temple, Rājat. 5, 23.
